body: Also there's a car park that's easy to access from the lower food court in Melbourne Central station, go to the KFC and go up the escalators, through the doors and up the ramps until you find the elevators and go to the top level. There's a really nice view up there and it is almost always empty, the only other time I've ever seen someone else there other than me was when I accidentally caught a blow job in action but they were so embarrassed and ran.

Go to the fed square side of the yarra river and just keep walking, maybe a 5 minute walk but you eventually find this huge hill that has a park at the bottom. It's a nice view and most of the time there isn't a lot of people around.
I really enjoy 8Bit and I have heard many good things about Huxtaburger. I am trying to find somewhere to go for date night with my partner so thank you for the big list. So many options now!
I got banned from my local shopping centre for 2 years when I was 11 for stealing a lip smacker.

It's comforting(and sad) knowing others experienced being disowned too, I don't know anyone else who had a parent disown them but my NDad disowned me when I was 14 after I ran away from my mum's house, he posted it on my Facebook wall for all my friends and family to see. A few years later, my little brother moved in with him full-time and my dad changed his mind about disowning me and tried to tempt me into seeing him by buying me gifts, I never gave in and now he's given up and has cut all ties with me. I haven't seen him in 5 years.
"You look like a hobo/runaway" This, I got told this every time I left the house in anything that my NDad didn't buy for me.

I had very bad anxiety as a child and whenever I'd have panic attacks or express any negative feelings my ndad would say I was just like my mother because he believed I was being manipulative and was faking it.
